currencies.title: Currencies.
currencies.ledePrimary: Every price is stored in the primary currency ({{code}}).
currencies.ledeRest: Other published currencies are for display only: customers see an approximation and always pay in the primary currency. Rates are units of the currency for one unit of the primary.
currencies.codeHint: Three letters, for example EUR. It cannot change later.
currencies.symbolHint: Shown before the amount. The code is used when empty.
currencies.decimalsHint: 0 for currencies without cents. Prices in the primary currency cannot have more decimals.

countries.lede: Customers can only use published countries in their addresses. A country with published states needs one of them in every address. A postal code can be required and checked against a pattern.
countries.codeHint: Two letters (ISO 3166-1), for example VN. It cannot change later.
countries.patternHint: Optional regular expression the whole code must match. Needs “Postal code required”.
countries.noStates: No states yet. Addresses in this country use a free text state.

currency.approximate: Prices in other currencies are approximate. Payment is always in {{code}}.
